supercharger_access.notes: Polestar Canada: Polestar 2 is compatible with the NACS adapter (ordered via a Polestar Service Point).
US: Polestar 2 owners can order the NACS adapter ($230) through Service Points (Polestar official quoted by InsideEVs).

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 120 km/h steady, 11 °C, dry, 20-inch wheels (245/40-20 Continental SC6), battery-side (car display; sheet does not say explicitly) | Nyland, 'Polestar 2 Performance 2024' (dual motor Performance, 79.1 kWh measured, 82 kWh refresh pack). Our variant shows 78/75 kWh from OpenEV, which looks stale for the 2024+ refresh; I attached the test to the real refresh car, so check our pack figure. 90 km/h, 11 °C: 169 Wh/km. Winter row for 'Polestar 2 LR DM' 2024 (not Performance, 19-inch, -6 °C wet): 266 Wh/km, not used..

charge_port.notes: Estimated: North American Polestar 2 has a CCS1 port: Polestar Canada sells a NACS-to-CCS1 adapter for the Polestar 2 and the US checker lists Polestar as a paid adapter, so there is no native NACS port. Applies to 2025; no port change found across 2021-2025.
Estimated: The Charge Port 2026 US checker lists Polestar 2 (2021-2025) as CCS1 (adapter needed for Superchargers).
